method: Actual browser scene camera moved around15m boundary; target instance identified in each LOD InstancedMesh by its world x/z matrix translation. Captures inspected for comparable height/footprint.
passMeaning: Functional bucketing: target instance is in LOD0 before the15m threshold and LOD1 after it. This does not claim invisible cross-fading.
visualObservations: Final near model is a portable radial branch mesh with short foliage cards; no full-height photo card or preview-only seam shader.
Height and overall footprint remain comparable across the boundary.
A visible change in individual bough silhouette remains when the near geometry switches to the medium full-tree impostor. The asset uses a discrete LOD transition, not a cross-fade.

evidence.derivation: Lossless WebP export of actual browser PNG capture; identical decoded RGBA pixels, no crop or retouch
